title: ETs arrived en masse after the first atomic bomb

tellings.quote: after we detonated the first atomic bomb, the ETSs came in on force in mass

plain: After the first atomic bomb went off in 1945, extraterrestrials came to Earth in force and in large numbers, according to Steven Greer, a UFO disclosure campaigner. Greer states this as his own view and names no source. If true, it would mean nuclear weapons are what drew the visitors here.
